name: GRID_ISOMORPHISM_DISGUISE
description: Disguises the Independent Set problem on a graph as a 2D grid placement problem. Vertices become cells on the main diagonal, and edges become pairs of symmetric cells containing sensors. The independent set constraint is enforced by requiring that no sensor is hit by more than one laser beam from the diagonal beacons. This prevents the model from immediately recognizing the graph structure and applying specialized bitset branch-and-bound graph algorithms, forcing it to fall back to generic backtracking which will TLE on the 5-second limit for N=46.
